notes:
# Listen to a meeting while it records {headphones}
Your phone can hear what the recording is hearing, live. It is the
recording's own mixed sound -- what the file will have -- so it is never
the Mac's microphone on its own, and nothing extra is captured to send
it. Turn it on per phone under Settings > Remote.

# Connect a phone by typing a code {iphone}
The Mac shows eight characters under the QR now, so a phone can be
connected without scanning anything. That matters for a remote added to
an iPhone Home Screen: scanning opens Safari, which is a different place
as far as the phone is concerned, so it paired the browser and the icon
on the Home Screen went on saying it was not connected.

---

Everything else in this release:

- Connected phones are a list you manage: what each one may reach, when
  it last asked for anything, and audio or screen access you can take
  back at any time.
- Stop works from anywhere. A stop sent from a phone used to leave the
  Mac still offering to stop it, until the run vanished from under it.
- The remote's screens each start at their top, and its title bar leaves
  room for the phone's clock when the app is saved to a Home Screen.
- Choosing a time zone slides up properly, can be pulled down to close,
  and stops above the keyboard rather than behind it.
- Confirming a recording, and the screen after it, look like the
  recording they are about -- the same card the lists use. A recording
  opened from Past recordings lands on the row it was opened from.
